patches.title: Strip credentials from CURLINFO_EFFECTIVE_URL
patches.description: Backport upstream credential removal for effective URLs after .netrc authentication and redirects.

dep3.origin: Manual context port of upstream commit 7a6bd027d0de2b6857472d35da090ef60cc29f19; zero-fuzz application verified against Debian Trixie curl 8.14.1-2+deb13u7.

tests.baselineExpectation: With a local 301 redirect and .netrc fixture, exact installed vulnerable curl returns an effective URL containing the fixture credentials.
tests.patchedExpectation: The same transfer succeeds and reports the final URL without user or password components.
